## ICacheRpc type

RPC cache request structure.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ICacheRpc = {
    method: string | string[];
    params: Record<string, unknown>;
    [moreRoot: string]: unknown | string;
};
```

## Remarks

JSON-RPC-ish envelope used between instances to forward a cache operation. Produced wherever a cache call is serialized for transport and consumed wherever the receiving side dispatches it back onto a `CacheExternal` handle. The fixed fields carry the dispatch target while the index signature leaves room for transport-level extras.
